scope.bounded: The three DR-6 cross-vents for the RTD blind ports, the 6061-T6 physical material assignment, and the CP-15 mass verification. Continues the saved document.
scope.vent_routing_decision: DECISION (design agent): each vent is the shortest safe O(rtd_vent_dia) path from the port's blind-end level (rtd_depth - rtd_vent_dia/2 above Datum A) to an already-vented volume. VENT1 (r40@75) drills to the central He bore - an OD entry would be an infeasible ~80:1 drill. VENT2 (r100@165) drills the chord to the coaxial-radius lift-pin bore at 150 deg, 26 mm. VENT3 (r140@225) drills radially to the OD, 20 mm. ALTERNATIVES REJECTED: all-OD entry (RTD1 infeasible), bottom-face angled drills (would breach the masked sealing/land zones and complicate the lapped face). All paths verified clear of the channel envelope (vents span radii the channel cannot occupy at z 6-12) and of neighbouring features by azimuth. Chord/OD centres are precomputed from the parameter clockings and cited here; the z level stays parametric.
scope.deferred: Masking sketches S9/S10 (features 28/29) and edge breaks (27) move to the drawing package - their only consumer is the drawing sheet. Retainer-tap venting is the SEWCP-1000 retainer interface's stated practice (vented fasteners) and is recorded as an observation, not modelled here.
scope.open_state: ECR-Q-011 (rib, provisional 5.0), the developed-path shortfall, and CP-02 remain open; none of this work depends on them.

requirements.statement: Each RTD blind port is cross-vented per DR-6 with an O(rtd_vent_dia) drill at the blind-end level, into an already-vented volume: VENT1 to the central He bore, VENT2 to the lift-pin bore at 150 deg, VENT3 to the plate OD. No trapped volume remains at the three ports.
requirements.verification: Vent planes and sketches observed; pump-down qualification (hardware)

drills.rationale: RTD1 (r40@75) vented into the central He bore: run r0-42 crosses no channel (no pass wall below r62.9) and no neighbouring feature at 75 deg.
RTD2 (r100@165) vented via the 26 mm chord to the lift-pin bore (r100@150); the chord midpoint sits on the 157.5 deg radial at r99.14, between the channel passes at 82.9 and 118.4.
RTD3 (r140@225) vented radially to the OD, 20 mm run r138-161, clear of the ring taps (202.5/247.5) and choke stations (210/240) by azimuth.

requirements.statement: Mass <= 4.2 kg with 6061-T6 assigned (rho 2700). The section 5 estimate is ~4.0 kg after the channel and bores; the observed model mass verifies it.

Vents are gun-drilled O1.5 at depths 20-36 mm (13:1 to 24:1), each from an open access: through the He bore, through the lift-pin bore, and from the OD - drilled at step 9 with the other bores, before anodize masking.

interfaces.nature: Blind ports now DR-6 vented; retainer-tap venting is the retainer interface's vented-fastener practice
